root_cause: The header component incorrectly applies aria-hidden=true to the navigation menu when the menu button is hidden (desktop view), removing the navigation links from the accessibility tree.
repair_strategy: Modify Header.prototype.syncState to conditionally apply aria-hidden only when the menu button is visible (mobile); otherwise ensure the navigation is visible by removing aria-hidden.
expected_accessibility_effect: Navigation links will be present in the accessibility tree as links, allowing screen reader users to navigate to them via Tab and hear their correct name and role.
functional_risks: If the window is resized after initialization, the menu button visibility may change and the aria-hidden state may not update until the next menu button click or page reload.
The conditional check relies on offsetParent; if the button is hidden via other means (e.g., visibility:hidden) offsetParent may still be non-null, potentially leaving aria-hidden incorrectly set.
verification_requirements: Verify that the AX assertion for #nav-apply (name: "Apply", role: "link") passes after the change.
Verify that the menu button still functions correctly on narrow viewports: clicking toggles aria-expanded and applies/removes aria-hidden on the navigation.
Ensure that when the menu button is hidden (desktop), the navigation does not have aria-hidden attribute and remains accessible.
